title: Functional
text: Functional. Smallish basket would hold a hot dog and some fries maybe. Not that well made for long term use. I think I will use it for a small planter type idea I have.

product_metadata.title: G.E.T. 4-22454 Stackable Metal Wire Bread Basket, 9" x 5.25"
features: STYLE: From fun and quirky to traditional shapes, these vessels can serve a range of fried side dishes like french fries, onion rings, fried okra and tater tots
DURABLE: Mainly made from stainless steel with a few pieces made from chrome-, powder- or teflon-coated metal, this collection is extremely durable
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Stainless steel pieces are dishwasher-safe, anything coated with chrome, powder or teflon are recommended hand-wash only
description: The Specialty Servingware collection is all about fun and engaging guests. Many pieces feature charming styles like rocket- or boat-shaped onion ring servers, and even a taco holder and a basket shaped like a guitar. To balance the collection, we also included some traditionally-shaped cups, cones and grid baskets perfect for fried side dishes. Any way you decide to use these pieces, you’re sure to get the ”Wow!” reaction all chefs crave.
